name: Iron brazier
description: A standing wrought-iron brazier about 1 m high: a wide fire bowl with a rolled rim on three splayed legs tied by a ring brace, heaped with black coals glowing orange at the heart under low flames.

provenance.prompt: An iron fire bowl on three legs, about 0.7 x 0.7 x 1.1 m, burning coals; anchors fire:bowl and light:fire.
